name: Genfo
steps: Bring measured water and salt to a brisk boil in a sturdy saucepan.
Sprinkle barley flour into the boiling water while stirring vigorously with a strong wooden spoon. Lower the heat.
Stir and fold for 12–15 minutes, scraping the base, until no dry flour remains and the stiff porridge is fully cooked.
Melt butter in a small pan and warm berbere in it for 30 seconds. Mound the genfo on a platter, make a central well and pour in the spiced butter.
Serve immediately, dividing into four portions. Keep extra hot water nearby if the porridge becomes too stiff to stir.
tips: Choose a berbere blend without meat stock or animal ingredients.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
